angleEvidenceBrief: Slot 1 proves that the mass of this payroll sits well to the left of its own average: median 31,420 EUR against a mean of 36,516 EUR, with 151 of the 234 answered returns below the mean and a thin right tail running to 238,530 EUR. Every figure in the title, the standfirst, the two rules, the tail note and the alt text is computed by render.mjs from source/data.csv and printed before the render; nothing is typed. The six blank returns are dropped from the geometry, counted in the standfirst, and cross-checked against source/profile.json. The PNG was opened and read at 1920x1080 on the newsroom own dark ground.
reviewer: the journalist (this run: the decision was taken on their behalf, see NOTES-FOR-MAINTAINER.md)
notes: inspectSvg reports 0 failing and 0 unresolved painted runs against the real ground. frameFillFraction on the delivered PNG is 0.777 against a 0.3515 floor. revealDashInScreenSpace returns [] over the two dashed rules. assertDeliveredSize, assertTypeFloor, assertWithinStage and assertDrawnInActiveTypeface all pass. Two defects found by looking rather than by a counter: the first render collided the axis floor label with the first derived tick, and framingMeasurement returns null for largestAgainstMedian on this treatment marks because the median bin count of a right-skewed distribution is 0.
